# Contract: vlog-auto-edit

Third-party skill from [znyupup/ai-video-editing-skill](https://github.com/znyupup/ai-video-editing-skill) (MIT, nyx研究所 (znyupup)), `b6429ab`. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Mixed-footage edit, including a quiet music mix under speech). The method is upstream. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Assemble many short clips into one video with ffmpeg: an inventory, a cut plan, section titles, and a quiet music mix.

## Use it for
- "cut this folder of clips into a vlog"
- "assemble b-roll with ffmpeg"

## Not for
- one talking-head take (rough-cut)
- a browser demo (scripted-screencast)
- a shader loop (code-loop)

## Accepted inputs
A folder of raw clips. Optional vision-model endpoint if the user wants shot labels; the skill does not ship a key.

## Deliverables
Clip inventory, edit plan JSON, titled segments, and a mixed final.mp4.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local ffmpeg and Python. A vision API is used only when the user supplies an endpoint and key.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None for the local path. A vision API is the user's account if they turn it on.

## Human decisions
- Which clips stay
- Music level under speech

## Quality checks
- Speech is not cut mid-word
- Segment audio and video durations match
- A person watches the cut

## Common failures
- Concat of mismatched encodes
- Whisper text on music with no speech

## Limitations
